h1: Suntisuk Place Prachinburi — A Simple, Easy-Parking Stay for a Few Hundred Baht
intro: If you want a low-budget place to crash in Prachinburi that's easy to drive in and out of, lets you park right by your door and won't cost much — Suntisuk Place is a small roadside stay on Suwannason Road (Route 33) in Ban Phra subdistrict, in the Noen Hom area of Mueang Prachinburi. Around 16 simple Standard double and twin rooms, with free parking, free Wi-Fi and a small garden. Rates start at about ฿600/night. The trade-off is that it sits outside the town centre and the rooms are basic, but they're clean enough and good value for drivers passing through or stopping over before heading up to Khao Yai.

body.html: Suntisuk Place is a small roadside stay at 44 Moo 15, Ban Phra subdistrict, on Suwannason Road (Route 33), in the Noen Hom area of Mueang Prachinburi. The thing guests mention most is the location right on the main road — easy to drive in and out of, with a wide lot where you can park by your door. It suits anyone driving through or using this road to reach Khao Yai from the Prachinburi side and wanting a quick overnight without going into town.

There are around 16 rooms, mostly Standard with a queen bed or twin beds. Each has air conditioning, satellite TV, hot water, a tea/coffee set and basic bathroom toiletries. The styling is plain and straightforward rather than fancy, but most reviews say the rooms are clean and roomy enough for the price. It's a place that delivers on a good night's sleep and convenience more than on design.
"Clean room, comfy bed, you can park right outside the door, friendly staff and the price is low — a handy stop before heading up to Khao Yai."

Beyond the rooms, the property also has a small garden, a massage service and a banquet hall for weddings or functions with a Thai buffet. Parking holds around 15 cars and Wi-Fi is free in the common areas and rooms. The overall feel is quiet and suburban — better suited to a calm rest than to finding entertainment on site.

To be honest, the main limitation is that it's outside the town centre, so you can't really walk anywhere and you need a car. The property sits on Route 33, a fair way from central Prachinburi and the markets, and it's awkward without your own transport. The front desk also keeps set hours rather than running 24/7 — if you arrive late, call ahead on 092-945-3441 to arrange key pickup.

Another thing to allow for is that the property is on a main road, so some rooms catch road noise, and the amenities are basic for the price — there's no pool or gym. At this budget the focus is on simplicity, cleanliness and easy parking. If you're expecting a stylish hotel or a full amenity list, this isn't it; but if you want a clean, cheap bed in a location that's easy to drive to, it fits the bill.

Overall, Suntisuk Place scores 7.8 out of 10 from around 108 real reviews on Agoda. It's a budget stay that works for drivers, short-stay workers visiting Prachinburi, or travellers using this road up to Khao Yai. Rates start around ฿600 and climb to about ฿900 depending on the season and room type. If you can accept the out-of-town location and the simple rooms, it offers good value at its price point.

faq.q: Where is Suntisuk Place in Prachinburi, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Suntisuk Place is at 44 Moo 15, Ban Phra subdistrict, Mueang Prachinburi, on Suwannason Road (Route 33) in the Noen Hom area. It's about 240 m from the King Naresuan Shrine roundabout, around 15 minutes' drive from the town centre and markets, and sits on the Prachinburi approach road to Khao Yai.

faq.q: How much does Suntisuk Place cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿600/night for a Standard Double (queen) room. There are both double and twin Standard rooms. Prices rise to around ฿900 depending on the season and weekends — always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Suntisuk Place have parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's free parking for around 15 cars, with space near the rooms, plus free Wi-Fi in both the rooms and common areas. It's a point real reviews often praise for self-drivers.

faq.q: What are the rooms at Suntisuk Place like — are they clean?
faq.a: The Standard rooms are simple, with air conditioning, satellite TV, hot water and a tea/coffee set. Most reviews say the rooms are clean and roomy enough for the price. They're not stylishly decorated — the focus is on cleanliness and convenience over design.

faq.q: Who is Suntisuk Place best for?
faq.a: It's best for self-drivers, short-stay workers visiting Prachinburi, or travellers using this road up to Khao Yai. Because it's on Route 33 outside the town centre, it isn't ideal for anyone who wants to explore town on foot or arrives without a car.

faq.q: Can I check in late at Suntisuk Place?
faq.a: The front desk keeps set hours rather than running 24/7. If you're arriving late, it's best to call ahead on 092-945-3441 to arrange your arrival time and key pickup so you're not left waiting at the gate.
